coverage_gaps.reason: Existing libgo-ci.yml build-and-test macOS ASan/UBSan variant excludes GoChannelStressTest for intermittent timeout. The other 32 registrations are exact check members. This is an explicit coverage gap, not an expected skip, advisory pass or completed check; the realization audit must continue reporting the unclaimed registration until exclusion schema/policy is coordinated. Effective Test-step ASAN_OPTIONS is detect_leaks=0 (overrides the earlier strict_string_checks setting).

Initial logical inventory is non-enforcing: complete native/toolchain/sanitizer/optional profile union and exact registration membership require realization plus workflow migration. Existing legacy gates remain authoritative.
W11 measured baselines, 20 PRs, two broad runs and actual protection cutover NOT RUN; no selective production acceptance.
